Commentary.Commentary: What domination by South Africa! Moeen Ali gets four cheap wickets as the visitors aimed for quick runs. England need a massive 474 runs to win this game. Dean Elgar and Hashim Amla set the innings up for them with a big stand. Faf du Plessis then chipped in with a fifty. The lower order enjoyed their time in the middle. All England bowlers bowled their hearts out but did not have the results to show for it. The hosts' openers have a period of ten minutes to see off. Everything is stacked against them, let's see how they fare. Join us in a while for their chase.

OUT! Ali has his fourth! The perks of bowling with a declaration around the corner. This is a good return catch though, Philander went hard at it with a flat-batted hit but couldn't get the elevation. Moeen reacts sharply by moving across his left to take a sharp catch. With that, du Plessis signals from the dressing room that enough is enough, SOUTH AFRICA HAVE DECLARED.
Floated around off, driven back to the bowler.
SIX! Does it again! Another booming shot! Repeats the slog sweep and this time goes over deep square leg. Another huge maximum to Philander. The lead is now 473.

SIX! That's in the crowd! Cracking shot from Philander and it's a biggie. Fetches his off break from outside off stump and unleashes the slog sweep over deep mid-wicket. Booming hit and it's gone all the way!
Tries to repeat the slog but doesn't time it well. Single down towards long on.
Long off and long on in place.

FOUR! Morkel is having some fun! Tossed up around off, he gets under it and lifts it straight down the ground. Clears mid on comfortably as it goes to the fence for a boundary. It was hit straighter, so a long on might not have mattered.
Philander takes a drink between overs. The 12th man might have come out with a message, or so we think.
Fullish and outside off, leans forward and drives it towards backward point. Single taken.
Flighted outside off, Morkel goes for a big lofted shot but makes no contact.
Drifting in on a length outside off, defended off the back foot towards mid on.
Tossed up wider outside off, Philander drives towards extra cover. Cannot beat the fielder. Single taken.
Drifting in from around off, driven firmly back to the bowler.
Fullish and outside off, driven just past the bowler towards mid off. Some mix up in the running but they get back in time.
FOUR! Hammered away! Floated on off stump, Morkel leans into it and bludgeons it over the bowler's head this time. Clean strike and finds another boundary.
Full and outside off, presses forward to that one and smothers it to the covers.
Floated around off, Morkel looks to slog on the leg side but mistimes it towards mid on. Just short of the fielder.

FOUR! BOOM! That's dismissed from his presence. Tossed up outside off, Morkel leans forward and thumps it straight down the ground. In the air but well wide of the mid off fielder as it rockets to the fence. Lead is now 450!
Drifting in around middle, nudged off the back foot towards the leg side for a brace.
Floated around middle, stays back and works it on the leg side.
Morkel returns the chest guard. We are in for some big shots here.
On middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and defends solidly.
Four Byes! That's taken off! Wow! Spins in with steep bounce off the rough, Morkel gets out of the way in time after initially looking to flick. It races down to the fine leg fence.
Floated on a length outside off, gets back and taps it towards the bowler.
Loopy and outside off, reaches out and drives it towards long off for a single.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards short extra cover.
Liam Dawson is back on.
Floated around middle, gets back and works it with the turn on the leg side for a single.
Morne Morkel is the new man in.

OUT! Another good catch! Broad it is this time and Maharaj has to go. Steps out to play the lofted stroke but skews it down the ground. Broad from long on charges up and races to his left to take a fine tumbling catch. Well done by the tall England pacer. The lead is now 437, is a declaration around the corner? If he doesn't do it quickly, he won't get the chance as there are just 2 wickets left.
Floated outside off, leans forward and blocks it towards cover.
Stays low! South Africa won't mind this with the lead they have. Maharaj tries to play back to this drifter but it sneaks beneath the bat.
Drifting in around middle, worked with the turn towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, Philander drives well but straight towards mid off.
On a length angled in around off, Maharaj looks to fend but gets an edge towards backward point.
Length ball outside off, defended solidly off the back foot to the off side.
Play and a miss! Shortish and wide outside off, Maharaj flashes at it but fails to connect.
Dug in short just outside off, Maharaj sways away from the line of the bumper.
Shortish around middle, swivels to pull it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Length ball angled in around middle, gets back and taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Keshav Maharaj is the new man in.

OUT! GOOD CATCH BY BALLANCE! Seems like the message has come out for the Protea batsmen to push for the declaration. Morris goes for the slog sweep but miscues it high on the leg side. Ballance from backward square leg covers ground to his left before taking a fine diving catch. Good piece of fielding.
Uppish but safe! Some intent from Morris as he tries to big down the ground. Slices it high over extra cover as it falls in no man's land. A couple taken.
Shorter in length and Vernon hangs back to work it with the turn through square leg for a single.
Drifting in around middle, gets back and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Floated around middle, driven firmly back to the bowler.
Some turn for Ali! The off break turns in from a shortish length, Philander hangs back to push at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Moeen Ali is back on.

Dead ball! Morris cannot believe it and one cannot fault him. Sprayed down the leg side, he tries to flick as it goes off the pads towards the fine leg fence. The umpire feels that Morris wasn't trying a shot and so signals a dead ball. Strange call, that!
On a length around middle, gets across and tucks it through backward square leg for a brace.
Back of a length around middle, gets back and defends it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Crashed! Half volley outside off, a bit of width and that allows Morris to free his arms. Smashes the drive through the covers to find the boundary.
Fullish on off stump, Morris tries to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Leg bye! Shortish and angled into the body, Philander gets across to flick but misses as it goes off the thigh pad down the leg side. They take a leg bye.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends firmly.
On a slightly shortish length around middle, blocked off the back foot down the pitch.
FOUR! Classy from Morris! On a length outside off, he gets forward and dishes out a punchy drive past the bowler. Beats mid off comfortably as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Back of a length around off, stays back and works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length outside off stump, Morris hangs back and bunts it to cover for a single.
Shortish around off, nips in with bounce as Philander takes his bottom hand off to tap it on the leg side. Single taken.
Spears it in around middle, leans across and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Angled into the sticks, Morris defends firmly with a straight bat towards cover.
Bairstow is gettng some attention to his hand. It's surely stung him.

Very full and outside off, Philander tries drive but gets a bottom edge that goes on the bounce towards Bairstow. Dies on him and gets past him after he gets hit on the thumb. Lobs it over Cook at first slip as the batsmen get a single.
Fuller on off, leans across and drives sweetly towards mid on.

Four Byes! That sneaked past everyone! On a length around leg stump, shoots through low off the deck as Vernon misses the flick again. Bairstow has no chance with the low bounce as the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Slips one down the leg side, Philander fails to clip it away.
DRINKS!
Good length outside off, Morris defends it.
Morris gets in line of the ball and defends it.

An interesting stat, England haven't successfully chased a total in excess of 150 over the last five years. In the 20 attempts batting last, they have only succeeded five times with 144 being their highest chase. Enough to suggest that South Africa have enough already on the board, statistically at least.
Shorter in length now, Morris ducks under it.
Leg gully in place.
Good length outside off, bounces more, Morris leaps and defends it watchfully.
Full around off, Morris looks to defend but gets it off the inner half towards the leg side.
On a length on the pads, turned towards the leg side.
FOUR! Good shot! Length ball outside off, Philander punches it through covers for a boundary.
Lands it outside off, left alone.
Full, outside off, driven to mid off.
Shorter outside off, cracked to point by Vernon.
Slings it down the leg side, Philander looks to put it away but misses.
Punches this towards covers from his crease.
Morris stays in his crease and defends it.
EDGED! Outside off on a length, Philander gets it wide of the gully fielder. Good running gets them three.
Drives this one towards mid off.
Fuller outside off, driven to covers.
Stays back and defends it watchfully.
Philander turns it towards mid-wicket.
Slips one down the leg side, Morris cannot clip it.
Bouncer on middle, Morris ducks under it.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Chris Morris is the new man in.

OUT! Unlucky Faf! Angles a length ball on off, comes in sharply, du Plessis looks to clip but is hit on his pads. The ball kept low and that made the job of the umpire easier. Faf reviews in vain as the Ball Tracker shows three reds. The skipper has to walk back. End of a good knock. LEAD 405!
Faf du Plessis has been given out lbw. He opts for the review rather quickly. Didn't seem to get bat on it, does he feel it's going down leg? Let's see.
Good length, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Turns it towards square leg for a single.
Full and around the stumps, Philander turns it towards mid on.
Comes in with the angle, Philander keeps it out.
Good length outside off, Philander shapes to push at it but is beaten all ends up.
Left alone by Philander outside off.
Outside off on a length, Philander comes forward to defend but is beaten.
Slants it down the leg side, Philander looks to clip it but misses.
Angles it on the stumps, du Plessis shapes to clip but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Stokes has his hands on his head.
Cracks a drive towards mid off.
Lands it outside off, left alone.
That held up! Outside off on a length, du Plessis is early into his punch as the ball comes off late. Almost pops it back to the bowler off the toe end of the bat.
Shorter in length around off, pulled through square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Philander mistimes it back down the wicket.
Slight delay as Stokes gets new socks for himself. He comes on for a bowl.
Nasser Hussain observes that England can have a short leg for Philander who has fended at many deliveries on his body. Missing a trick here?
Full and outside off, du Plessis is temped into the drive at first but then lets it go.
Outside off, left alone.
CLOSE! Length ball outside off, du Plessis hangs his bat at it. The keeper takes the catch and appeals. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. There was noise there, not sure of what.
Good length around off, Faf du Plessis defends it from his crease.
Good length around off, turned towards the leg side.
Good length around off, du Plessis turns it towards the leg side.
Mark Wood comes back on.
Punches it off his crease towards mid on from his crease.
Fuller around middle, clipped through wide mid on for a couple of runs.
Good length on the pads, Philander fails to clip it away.
Full and outside off, Philander pushes it towards covers.
Full and outside off, Philander absolutely creams it back to the bowler.
Outswinger outside off, Philander defends it from his crease.
Full on middle, clipped hard towards mid-wicket.
Angles it on a length, comes in sharply, Philander takes the bottom hand off and gets it towards backward square leg for a single. LEAD IS 400!
Full and outside off, Philander defends it from his crease.
FOUR! Edged! Length ball outside off, Philander comes forward and opens the face of the bat. The ball goes off the outer half through gully for a boundary.
FOUR! Lovely hit! Full and outside off, Philander gets under it and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Nasser Hussain spots that during a review while opting for it, England have no set plan. And Root is not thinking and is going with the instance of the bowlers.
Good length around off, Faf stays back and defends it.
Faf du Plessis comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tucks it behind square leg for a single.
Hurls it outside off, swings away, Philander pushes at it from his crease but is beaten.
Full and outside off, Philander angles it towards backward point.
Good length outside off, Philander plays a lovely punch off his back foot but straight to cover.
Full and outside off, no shot offered.
Angles a length ball outside off, du Plessis punches it towards the off side.
Good length outside off, swings in, left alone by Faf.
Full outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Top shot! Full and outside off, du Plessis comes forward and creams his drive through wide mid off for a boundary. Beautifully hit.

Full and into the pads, du Plessis looks to clip it but is hit on his pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. Root thinks Faf hit it. Replays show that there was no bat there. Root got that one wrong too. The ball was swinging down the leg side though.
Slips it down the leg side, Philander looks to whip it over the leg side but is beaten.

Back of a length around off, bounces more, Philander takes the bottom hand off the bat and fends at it. The ball flies towards the vacant short leg region. Philander was smart to save his bowling hand there.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Stays in his crease and defends it.
Length outside off, swings away, Philander plays and misses.
Wide outside off, left alone.

NOT OUT! Waste of a review! Bowls it around off, Faf is beaten on the inswing and rapped on his pads. The players go up in an appeal. Broad is almost celebrating while he is appealing. Joe Root goes for the review without even bothering to consult anyone. Replays confirm there was no bat there. Ball Tracker shows that the ball was bouncing over the stumps by some margin. Another review wasted by Root. Doesn't take when he should and wastes one when he shouldn't. Lots to learn for the new England skipper. Maybe Cook can help with his experience. Bowlers like Broad always think they have the wicket and he needs to show more composure while going for the reviews.
England have taken a review for lbw against du Plessis. Could be a touch high maybe.
There is a deep point in place to give Faf the single.
Slants it on the pads, Philander fails to clip it away. The ball rolls off the pads towards the leg side for a leg bye.
Goes wide of the crease, angles in a good length ball, Philander punches it to covers.
This time Philander gets in line and pushes it towards the off side.
Ouch! Good length outside off, comes in with extra bounce, Philander fends it away off the gloves.
Gets one to come in from outside off, du Plessis punches it back down the wicket. The mid on fielder cannot cut it off. A single results.
Stuart Broad returns for a burst with the second new cherry.
Shorter outside off, punched towards mid off by Philander.
An easy leave for Philander outside off.
Good length outside off, left alone by Philander.
Gets the outswinger going outside off, Vernon keeps it out.
A tad short outside off, Philander defends it.
Shorter outside off, du Plessis punches it wide of Broad at mid off. Stuart gets around and mops up. A single taken.
Enough of the spinners, James Anderson gets the second new nut.
Second new ball is due and TAKEN by England. The reviews are refreshed as well.
Shorter outside off, Philander defends it.
Vernon Philander comes out to bat. He will play his shots for sure. They can too with a lead so big. A slip and gully in place for him.

OUT! What a way to get out! Ali floats it outside off, Bavuma slinks down the wicket to go over long off. Mistimes it completely and Root takes the simplest of catches at mid off. The England skipper is all smiles. Another failure for Temba. SOUTH AFRICA LEAD BY 383 RUNS!
Short outside off, asking to be cut, Temba refuses.
Clips it towards deepish mid on for a single.
FOUR! Lofted! Floats it outside off, Faf du Plessis comes down and clips it over wide long on for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, punched towards point by Faf.
Loops it on off, Temba defends.
Lands it around leg, clipped towards the on side.
Fuller on middle, turned towards mid-wicket by Bavuma.
Shorter around off, punched to covers.
Eases this to long off for a single.
Flatter around off, punched to covers.

Well played, Faf! Short ball outside off, punched off the back foot by Faf du Plessis. Good timing means he gets three runs and that is a fifty for the South African captain. He will want to bat on and make it big. 13th Test fifty for Faf du Plessis.
Fuller around off, Bavuma comes down and clips it towards wide mid on for a single.
Gets across, low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, du Plessis comes forward and blocks it.
Bavuma comes down and hits it towards deep mid on for a single.
Floats it outside off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
Moeen Ali to bowl from the other end.
Nicely done! Clips this deftly to the vacant spaces square on the leg side and they pick up a brace.
Floated around off, Faf employs the premeditated paddle down to fine leg for a brace.
Drifting in from around off, pushed gently back to the bowler.
Floated around middle, dabbed gently to the leg side for a single.
Loopy on a length outside off, Bavuma thought about the cut stroke but then let it pass.
Flighted around middle, leans across and tucks it to the leg side.
The players return for the final session. Faf du Plessis and Temba Bavuma to bat on. Liam Dawson to roll his arm over to begin....
.... Day 3, Session 3 ....

Another fantastic session for South Africa. They have not scored at a good rate but with a lead of 366, they are firmly in control of the game. The England seamers kept it tight. The introduction of spinners lured Amla into a loose shot and he was out for 87. That was all that went the way of the hosts. England are being bowled into the ground here. How long will South Africa bat? Let's see. Join us for the final session in a while.
Drifting in from around off, defended off the back foot towards the leg side. TEA ON DAY 3.
Slightly short outside off, stays back and defends it towards cover-point.
Floated around middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Creamed! Ali switches to around the wicket but delivers a fuller ball outside off, Bavuma gets to the pitch of it with a stride forward and eases it through the covers. Finds the fence easily with the flawless timing.
Flatter and on the pads, whipped off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off stump, gets across and clips it towards square leg for a single.
Slightly short outside off, crunched off the back foot but towards cover.
Full and on middle, driven firmly back to the bowler.
Tossed up around middle, leans into it and defends with a straight bat.
Looped up nicely outside off, Temba checks his drive towards cover.
Low full toss outside off, Bavuma drives it sweetly to mid off.
FOUR! Clubbed away! Dragged in short around middle, Bavuma sits on the back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket. Clean strike and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Flighted on a length outside off, sits back and makes a leave.

FOUR! Super shot! Drifting in from outside off, du Plessis uses his reach and goes down on one knee to nail the sweep in front of square on the leg side. Made terrific contact as the ball rocketed to the fence.
Floated outside off, Bavuma gets across to that one and sweeps it with the turn to deep backward square leg. Single taken.
Flighted outside off, reaches out and pushes it towards cover.
Drifting in from around middle, Bavuma defends it off the back foot towards short leg.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back and blocks it solidly towards cover.
Slightly short outside off, stays back and pushes it towards cover-point for a single.
Flatter around leg stump, Bavuma stays back to whip it away but is struck high on the pads.
Full and outside off, leans forward and defends solidly.
Flighted around off, defended solidly off the front foot towards cover.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards mid off who is a tad deep. Single taken.
Flatter on a length outside off, swept towards long leg for a single.
Flighted around middle, defended down the pitch to the bowler.
Quicker ball on off stump, du Plessis goes back and taps it to the leg side.
Full and outside off, leans across and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter and outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Flighted again around off stump, gets across and drives it towards mid on.
Flighted outside off, Faf gets a stride forward and blocks towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in from around off, Bavuma looks to block but it goes off the outer half to the off side.
Flighted around middle, wristed to the right of mid on for a single.
Looped up on off stump, reaches out and defends towards mid-wicket.
Floated up around off, firmly defended off the front foot on to the pitch.
Drifting in from outside off, Faf presses forward and blocks solidly.
Flighted around off, driven firmly back to the bowler who stops it.
On a length outside off, Bavuma stays back to block but gets it off the edge towards point.
Tossed up on a length outside off, Bavuma walks across the stumps and blocks it on to the track.
Fuller around off, leans across and drives it towards mid on for a single.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back and blocks it solidly.
Drifting in from outside off, defends solidly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly to cover.
Temba Bavuma comes out to bat.

OUT! GOOD REVIEW! England haven't been good with DRS in this game but have got his right. Nicely tossed up around middle, Amla walks down the track to work across the line but is rapped on the pads. Appeal for lbw, turned down. Was he too far down the track? England decide to review it almost quickly. No bat involved and he isn't that far down the track. Hawk Eye shows the impact to be in line and going on to hit middle stump. Amla doesn't get the century and it's Dawson who has the last laugh in the battle.
Dawson is confident that he has trapped Amla lbw. Root goes for the review. That looks close actually.
Drifting in from outside off, gets back and defends it firmly to the off side.
Flatter outside off, Amla sits back and defends solidly.
Fuller and outside off, gets well forward and blocks it.
Mid off drops back.

FOUR! Shot! Amla's love for Dawson continues. Wastes no time in dancing down the track and chips it straight down the ground. Clears mid off and it seems to have gone all the way. The umpires want to check it and replays seem to suggest to the third umpire that it bounced just before the ropes.
Flighted around off stump, Amla gets forward and bunts it towards the bowler.
Spin from both ends now as Liam Dawson comes on to bowl.
Tossed up outside off, Amla leans into it and thumps the ball down the ground to long on. Single taken.
Flatter and on a length outside off, blocked nicely off the back foot.
Floated outside off, gets well forward and defends with a straight bat.
Floated wider outside off, leans across to that one and taps it down the track.
Slightly shorter and spinning in a touch from outside off, dabbed off the back foot to cover-point. They take a quick run.
Fullish and around off, du Plessis gets on the front foot and smothers it to the ground.
Length ball outside off, presses forward and defends solidly.

Not for the first time in the game, England have a problem with the shape of the ball. It's handed to the umpires who hand it back after an inspection. When it's not going your own way, nothing seems to work.
Good length closer to off stump, blocked solidly from the crease.

Had to hurry! On a length outside off, du Plessis taps it towards cover as they look to steal a quick run. Ali collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. a direct hit might have made it close.
Length ball outside off, Faf lets it pass.
Short of a length on off stump, Hashim gets across on the back foot and tucks it towards backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Classy shot! Back of a length around middle, gets on the back foot and flicks it through mid-wicket. Timed the pants off that one to send the ball across to the fence.

Shorter and outside off, Amla hangs back and slaps it to deep cover for a single. Brings up the 50-run stand, it's come rather slowly compared to the earlier stands of this game but South Africa won't mind or care. Bossing the game, they are.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back and blocks it firmly.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends solidly towards cover.
FOUR! Deft from Amla! Goes well across the sticks and plays a premeditated paddle shot down to the fine leg fence. Nicely done by the Mighty Hash, he continues to roll along.
Drifting in from outside off, defended solidly off the back foot to the covers.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back and punches it towards the covers.
Speared well wide outside off, that's a comfortable leave for du Plessis.

Shortish around off, Amla brings out his first pull stroke of the day. Single to deep backward square leg. He's been ducking and evading the short stuff today, almost as if in self-restraint but decides to let it out finally. He can afford to as well, with the lead hovering in the 320s.
Fullish and closer to off stump, nips in a bit as Amla makes a fine leave. He is so much in control of the situation that nothing seems to be bothering him. The Amla we all know!
On a good length outside off, Amla brings his bat down like a sledgehammer to meet the ball. Punched to mid off.
Length ball on fourth stump line, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball just outside off, Amla lets it pass through to the keeper.
Ali continues to bowl it from well outside off, another leave to end the over.
Floated wider outside off, this time Faf is happy to leave.
Beaten! Some excitement among the close-in fielders but du Plessis had missed it. Tries to sweep a ball from outside off stump but it sneaked beneath his blade. Bairstow didn't collect it cleanly.
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis gets forward and blocks it towards cover.
Slows it down and spears it wider outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover. In the gap and a single is taken.
Tossed up outside off, Amla walks across the stumps and defends it down the pitch.
Moeen Ali comes on to bowl after a long hiatus.
Fuller ball outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Full and in the zone around the off stump, another firm block off the front foot towards cover.
Length ball outside off, defended solidly off the front foot towards the off side.
Full and outside off, du Plessis presses forward to block but gets a faint inside edge on to the pads.
Good length just outside off, lets it pass through to the keeper.
On a length just outside off, du Plessis lets it pass through to the keeper.
Back of a length around middle, gets back and clips it down to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! More runs for Faf! Not entirely in control this time. Fullish and outside off, throws his hands as he goes for the square drive. Gets it off the outer half  through point as the ball trickles away to the fence. Some life into the innings in this over after a dull last hour.
Length ball around off, defended solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Crunched! Classy from du Plessis, sees the width on the half volley and he unleashes a open-faced drive through backward point. Totally in control and it races to the fence for a boundary.
Fullish and around off, opens up du Plessis a bit on the drive as it goes off the outer half towards extra cover.
On a length around off, angled in as Faf defends off the back foot towards silly mid on.
Drinks! Pretty dull period of play. Nothing happening. No scoring, few good balls but that is about it. England happy to contain, South Africa happy to tire them.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and angling on the stumps, turned through square leg for a single.
Lands it around off, on a length, Amla comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge through his legs for a single.
Amla comes forward and defends it off the inner half towards the leg side.
Angles it around off, Amla gets across and keeps it out.
Good length outside off, left alone by Amla. It is almost as if South Africa have decided to not play their shots and tire England down.
Back over the wicket, on a length, du Plessis defends it.
Amla turns it wide of short leg for a single.

Shorter again, Amla is not bothered as it leaves it. The umpire signals it two for the over. Wood accidentally ran over the danger area and quickly turned around hoping the umpire did not spot that. The umpire didn't so he is safe.
No leg slip now, a short leg is in place.
Bangs it short on middle, Amla ducks.
Shorter in length from round the wicket, Amla rides the bounce and taps it to the leg side.
OUCH! Shorter in length just around off, Amla shapes to leave it but is hit on his arms. The ball rolls towards the gully fielder. Wood is flat down on the wicket. Sums up England's innings so far.
Root wants the ball changed again. The umpire does not budge again.
Outside off, left alone.
Punches this one to the right of mid off who mops it up.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Broad bowls it outside off, du Plessis lunges forward and pushes it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary. Broad was on his knees after bowling that one.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Faf.
Lands it around off, du Plessis shapes to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length ball outside off, du Plessis defends it.
Time for Stuart Broad. England have done well to not let South Africa score at will.
Goes round the wicket and bowls it on middle, short only, dragged through mid-wicket for a single.
Ohh! Short ball on middle and leg, du Plessis rides with it and fends it towards the leg side. Well played, that.

FOUR! Oh my word! A boundary! Shorter ball outside off, Faf du Plessis makes some room for himself and punches it through covers for a boundary. Can't believe it while I write that. Runs have been hard to come by.
A lady has dozed off at the ground. Can't fault her, honestly.
Amla rides the bounce on this one and turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, Amla arches back and watches it sail through.
Good length around off, Amla defends it watchfully.
Shorter in length outside off, Faf rides the bounce and defends it. Stokes calls for drinks for himself.
Slants it on the pads, Amla clips it past the diving backward square leg fielder for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Good length outside off, angled towards gully from Hashim.
Fuller outside off, Amla is happy to let it go.
A short ball which is pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Goes for the full one but is on middle and leg, Amla keeps it out watchfully. A maiden by Wood.
Back of a length outside off, Amla stands tall and defends it.
Leg gully in place.
Good length on middle, Amla turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Broad is warming up.
Amla gets behind this one and defends it.
Shorter again outside off, Amla arches back and lets it go through.
Shorter outside off, Amla punches it towards backward point. Wood is down on his knees, he too seems to have landed wrongly there.
Amla gets across and turns it towards the square leg region.
Shorter outside off, punched towards extra cover. Root goes to his left, slides and fumbles. That allows the single.
Stokes wants some work to be done near the landing area of the bowling. The groundstaff is out with the hammer to level it.
Shorter around off, du Plessis looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Good length outside off, no shot offered.
Fuller outside off, Faf comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Shorter in length, pulled down to long leg for a run.
Tucks it towards square leg again from the crease.
Good length around off, nudged towards square leg from his crease.
A tad short outside off, du Plessis defends it towards gully very late.
Good length outside off, no shot offered.
Shorter in length around off, du Plessis lets it go over him.
Mark Wood returns for a burst. Important that England keep the pressure on South Africa.
Wide outside off, Amla is not interested in this.
Shorter in length this time, outside off, Amla raises his bat and lets it go.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot by Amla.
Short ball outside off, du Plessis smacks it through square leg for a single.
Shorter in length, du Plessis picks it early and ducks under it.
Good length around off, Faf lets it go through.
In the second innings, Amla has not played as many pull shots. Tells you an experienced batsman reacts to a poor dismissal.
Amla comes forward and lets this length ball go outside off.
That's the line! Hurls it outside off, Amla has a push at it but the ball goes away at the last moment and beats him. Only the second time Amla has been beaten today. Could not do anything about it.
FOUR! Close but put away! Drifts it on the pads, Amla clips it nicely to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Anderson needed to bowl that from outside off.
Length ball outside off, Amla presses forward and defends it.
Good length outside off, left alone by Amla. More words exchanged.
Slants it on the pads, du Plessis almost falls over as he clips it through square leg for a single. Anderson continues to blabber along to Faf.
Shortish outside off, Amla looks to push it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. A maiden by Stokes.
Angles a back of a length delivery around off, Amla is solid in his back foot defence.
Good length outside off, Amla gets behind it and defends it.
Banged in short outside off, Amla drops his wrists and lets it go through.
Short and going down leg, Amla is not bothered.
Slants it down the leg side, Amla gets across and lets it through. Stokes lost his footing there and hence drifted it down the leg side.
Du Plessis keeps his bat behind his pad and defends it towards the off side.
Pitched up around off, Faf comes forward and defends it.
Angles in a length ball outside off, du Plessis covers his stumps and lets it go.
This time he gets right behind the line and defends it watchfully.
Back of a length outside off, bounces more, du Plessis looks to put it away but is surprised by the extra lift as he cannot connect.
Good length outside off, shapes in, Faf keeps his bat close to him and lets it go through.
Angles a shorter length delivery around off, Amla gets across and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Amla defends it watchfully.

Hurls it outside off, Amla is lured into the forward push. The ball swings away and is beaten all ends up. Bairstow collects and flinches in pain. He didn't quite take it well. This is the first time Amla has played and missed one in this innings.
Good length outside off, nips in, Amla is not bothered.
Length ball outside off, Amla comes forward and defends it.
No slips for Amla. It is a strange field for a Test.
Shorter length outside off, Amla drops his wrists and lets it go.
Ben Stokes to run in from the other end.
Full around off, punch-driven towards mid off.
The banter between Faf du Plessis and James Anderson continues....
Full around off, Faf pushes it towards mid off from his crease.
FOUR! Edged! Lands it outside off, Faf comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge. It runs past the gully fielder and a  boundary results.
Faf comes forward and pushes it towards the off side.
Highest 4th innings total at Trent Bridge is 440. This isn't that good a wicket maybe for it.
Similar length, closer to the stumps though, another leave.
Starts with a good length ball outside off, left alone by Faf.

The players are out in the middle. Hashim Amla and Faf du Plessis stride out to bat. They will aim to bat on and extend the lead as much possible. James Anderson to begin the proceedings post the lunch break.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Another session for South Africa despite losing two quick wickets closer to the lunch break. Elgar and Amla continued to blunt the English bowling and were at ease before the former fell to a loose shot against Stokes. England got de Kock cheaply through Anderson but Amla has been solid amidst all this, showing his class. The lead is nearing 300 now and the Proteas will want to pile up the runs. No prizes for guessing what England need from here. Join us shortly for the second session.
Shortish around off stump, Amla gets right behind the line and defends it towards the bowler. Ends it well for SA. LUNCH ON DAY 3.
Slightly fuller this time and just outside off, nips in sharply as Amla offers a leave.
Shortish and around middle, Amla hops across the sticks and defends it to the leg side.
On a length and angling into Amla who tucks it off the back foot towards square leg.
Shortish and just outside off, Amla evades it by arching his back.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends it to the off side.
Length ball again in the corridor of uncertainty, Faf is watchful and lets it pass.
On a length around off stump, gets across and defends it solidly towards mid-wicket.
Anderson continues to probe around the off stump with a good length ball, fine leave from South African captain.
Good length ball just around off stump, Faf shapes for the back foot punch but the bat face turned in his hands. Mistimes it towards mid on.
On a good length around off stump, du Plessis stays in his crease and defends with a straight bat.
Length ball arrowing in on the pads, Amla glances it down towards fine leg for a single.
Shortish in length and du Plessis pulls but straight towards the man at square leg.
Slip comes in now.
Back of a length on leg stump, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Fullish ball outside off, Faf gets half forward and eases it towards mid off.
That kept low! Back of a length on off stump, Amla adjusts well to tap it towards cover for a run.
Another bumper from Stokes, he gets the same response from Amla who ducks under it.
Shortish and just outside off, Amla evades the bumper.
Almost a wicket! Length ball around middle, Faf tries to flick but closes the bat face too early. Gets a leading edge that just falls safely on the off side.

FOUR! Good shot to get off the mark! On a length around middle, du Plessis gets across and clips it just in front of square on the leg side. Initially, he was calling for two but he timed it so well that the ball raced away to the fence.
On a good length just outside off, probing line as du Plessis makes a good leave.
Faf du Plessis comes out to bat.

OUT! GOT HIM! Anderson provides his skipper with the breakthrough he wanted. Lands this on the perfect length just outside off, de Kock is lured into pushing at it but only manages to get a nick. Bairstow takes it with ease and South Africa have now lost two wickets quite quickly. The lead though is 284 and so they are fairly in control.
Back of a length around middle, de Kock shuffles across to work it on the leg side. The bounce does him in a bit as he taps it on to the track.
On a length outside off, de Kock stands tall and defends with a straight bat towards cover.
Jimmy Anderson is back on. Root will be hoping his premier strike bowler can ignite a collapse here with a new man in.

Snorter to get first up! De Kock will be happy he got away with it. Stokes digs it in short and angles it into the left-hander, Quinton tries to fend but gets into an awkward position. The ball flies off his forearm and it flies down towards fine leg. The umpire feels there was glove probably and so hasn't signaled anything. So, de Kock is off the mark.
Quinton de Kock comes out to bat. It will be interesting to see how he bats here. South Africa are a long way ahead at the moment.

OUT! STOKES STRIKES! A soft dismissal and the short ball ploy brings England a wicket. Dug in shorter outside off, Elgar gets across to pull but ends up in a tangle with his bat going nowhere. Took his eyes off the ball and so all he did eventually was spoon it to backward square leg where Anderson takes an easy catch. Much-needed strike for England but probably a bit late than they would have wanted.
Stokes continues to bang the deck, Elgar rises on his toes to defend it back to the bowler.
Again on the shorter length on leg stump, Amla stays on the back foot and defends towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length outside off, Elgar hangs on the back foot and defends it towards backward point.
Shortish just outside off, Elgar arches his back to evade the bumper.
STAT ALERT - Hashim loves Trent Bridge! 6 innings for Hashim Amla at this venue, he has scored a half-century at least in every innings. 2 of them for South Africa, 4 for Nottinghamshire.

FOUR! More runs! Doesn't matter if the line is negative, Amla isn't going to stop. Floated around leg stump, a bit full and he whips it through mid-wicket with full power to find the fence once more. There were shouts of 'Catch it!' but the ball reached the fence even before they could utter it properly.
Floated around leg stump, Amla stays back and whips it towards mid-wicket where it is well stopped.
Floated outside leg stump, Amla hangs back in his crease and allows the ball to rap his pads.
34th Test fifty for Hashim Amla.

SIX! Reaches the milestone in style! Flighted around off stump, Amla uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and dismantles it over long on for a biggie. Yet another Test fifty for Amla, second of the match and he seems hell bent on dominating the England spinners here. The lead swells to 279.
Full and around off, leans into it and defends it solidly.

FOUR! Smashed! Amla will not let Dawson settle, that's for sure. Steps out to this flighted delivery and launches it comfortably over mid on. Clean strike and that's another boundary for the veteran. Inches closer to another Test fifty.
Tighter line as Stokes gets this length ball closer to the off stump, Elgar though, is sure of where his off stump is and lets it pass.
Switches to around the wicket and delivers a length ball on fifth stump channel, watchfully left alone by Elgar.
Back of a length around middle, stays back and across to wrist it through backward square leg for a run.
Erratic delivery from Stokes, sprays it down the leg side as Amla shuffles across the sticks to make a leave.
Full and around off stump, swings in a bit as Amla looks to defend with a big front foot stride. Faint inside edge on to the pads.
Fine yorker on the base of off stump, Amla does well dig it out towards the off side. Good cricket all around.
Ben Stokes has a change of ends.
Fullish on the pads, Amla wrists it towards deep square leg for a single to keep strike.
Loopy and outside leg stump, Amla gets across and smothers it towards the short leg fielder.
There is a deepish mid on as Dawson goes over the wicket.

FOUR! Kaboom! Almost as if to say that the previous ball was an aberration. Flighted around off stump, Amla reaches out to that one and lofts it nonchalantly over the bowler's head. The ball races to the long off fence in no time.
Better length from Dawson, flights it outside off and Amla mistimes the attempted drive. Gets it off the inner half and the ball goes down the track.
Again on the shorter length, Amla punches it off the back foot towards mid on.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, Elgar camps back and whips it towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Liam Dawson comes on to bowl. England did have a chat with the umpire over the shape of the ball once more but yet again, they have been left resigned to the same cherry.
Shortish this time on leg, Elgar swivels to help it behind square on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Just short of a good length around off, extra bounce and Elgar rides it well by taking his bottom hand off at the last moment. The ball goes off the edge but on the bounce and beats gully to the fence. It might have come off the edge but the southpaw knew what he was doing there.
Good length delivery well outside off, Elgar doesn't offer a stroke.
Dug in short around middle, pulled towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Amla hangs back and lets it pass.
Length ball outside off, Amla doesn't offer a shot to that one.

Shaun Pollock notices that Anderson has a straight line from his point of release to his toes at the time of delivery. But that is not the same for Ben Stokes. But maybe, that is why Jimmy is the leading wicket taker for England?
Angles this length ball across the left-hander, this time Elgar lets it pass.
Length ball around off stump, Elgar gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
FOUR! Nicely done by Elgar! Shortish outside off, takes it on with a feisty pull through mid-wicket. Fairly in control and sends it to the fence for a boundary. Confident shot!
Back of a length just outside off, Elgar withdraws his bat to let it through.
Honing in on that zone just outside the off stump, Elgar has a good look at it and makes another leave.
On a good length angling in on fourth stump line, Elgar shoulders arms to make a leave.
FOUR! Gets it through! Shortish and outside off, Amla throws his hands at it and gets a slice that goes on the bounce through the slip cordon. No third man in place and it's a boundary.
Short ball closer to off stump, Amla evades the line of the bumper.
Tap and run from Elgar, nudges this length ball with soft hands towards cover as the batsmen scamper through for a single.
On a length around leg stump, Elgar shuffles a touch and clips it in front of square on the leg side. A couple taken.
Short ball around leg stump, Elgar is happy to duck under it.
Fullish and angled in around off stump, Amla pushes at it but gets a faint inside edge on the pads. The ball trickles towards square leg as the batsmen get a single.

Drinks time. Perfect hour for South Africa. Elgar has played and missed but survived importantly. Hashim Amla was let off and he has been solid as ever since then. Lead is growing all the time. England under pressure.
Good length outside off, bounces more on the batsman, Elgar defends it towards point.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar defends it off his crease.
Edged! Lands it outside off, Elgar gets outside the line and plays it with soft hands. The edge does not carry to the keeper. Root was appealing for an lbw.
Good length around off, Amla turns it towards the leg side for a single. Stokes looks to stop it from happening going to his right but cannot do so.
Full around off, Amla comes forward and defends it.
Shorter in length around middle, Amla raises his bat and lets it go. The ball follows him yet he manages to let it go.
Stokes to bowl round the wicket now. Maybe they will look to bowl short and on the body of the batsman.
FOUR! Nicely done! Elgar comes forward and taps this between the gully fielders for a boundary to third man. The frustration continues for the home side.
Shorter in length around middle, Elgar ducks under it.
Good length around off, bounces more on Dean, Elgar taps it towards gully from his crease. Well played.
Elgar turns it towards the leg side from his crease.
Slants it on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Amla defends it from his crease.
Elgar gets outside the line and defends it watchfully.
Fuller around off, Elgar turns it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Bad ball and punished! Fuller around off, now since Elgar is batting on off stump, he clips it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary this time.
Good length wide outside off, nothing doing from Elgar.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar looks to work it through mid-wicket but the bowler himself runs to his left and stops the ball. Does not concede the single. Well done.
Shorter outside off, Elgar lets it go through dropping his wrists.
Double change, Ben Stokes comes in for a burst. He too hasn't quite been at his best.

Wrong line! Drifts it on the pads, Elgar clips it through mid-wicket. Broad gives it a chase from mid on and keeps the ball in play with a slide. Saves a run for his side. The umpire refers it upstairs but replays find Broad fine and that is a good effort. Lead is now 234!
Hurls it outside off, left alone this time by Elgar.
And again! Wood angles it outside off on a length, Dean pokes at it and is beaten yet again. England cannot believe their luck today.
Nicely bowled! Good length outside off, Elgar hangs his bat out for it and is beaten by the away swing. He has played and missed at quite a few.
Full and wide outside off, Elgar tempts him but Dean does not fall for it.
Starts with a length ball outside off, left alone by Elgar.
Mark Wood called on for a bowl. He has not made a mark in this series yet.
Birthday Boy Shaun Pollock shows that both Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock have a very good flow of the bat which helps them control their shots better.
Good length outside off, left alone by Amla.
Angles it on a good length around off, Amla turns it with a swivel towards mid-wicket. He has been relatively safe and secure.
And again, Elgar turns it towards silly mid on. Ali parries it towards mid off and they steal a single.
Being aware of the plan, Elgar gets across and clips it towards the leg side.
Deep point, a silly mid on, two gullies in place. England trying to catch Elgar on the loose drive square of the wicket.
Full and outside off, Elgar pushes it towards point coming forward. Dean is pushing at fuller ones just wide outside off, does not need to play at these.
Good length around off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single. 100 up for South Africa.
Back of a length outside off, Dean defends it.
Good length around off, Elgar comes forward and defends it.
Good length around off, Amla looks to turn it through the leg side but gets an inside edge past his stumps for a single. England are getting a bit grumpy.
Good length around off, Amla defends it from his crease.
Short and outside off, Amla cracks it towards backward point and this time Stokes stops it.

FOUR! Poor fielding! Back of a length outside off, Amla punches it through backward point. The fielder, Ben Stokes gets a hand to it but cannot stop the ball. A boundary results. Stokes flinches in pain.
Dean comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller length outside off, left alone by Elgar.

DROPPED! Fuller outside off, Elgar looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards Anderson at gully. Jimmy flies to his left but cannot hold onto it. Elgar got out similarly in the first innings. There was a chance of a run out at the bowler's end but no harm done. Another chance gone missing. England haven't helped themselves here.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar rides the bounce and taps it towards covers.
Length ball outside off, Elgar comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Good length around the stumps, Elgar gets across and taps it towards the on side.

Good length around off, Elgar comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge towards backward square leg for a single. These two know that Anderson and Broad won't be bowling too long and hence are taking their time.
This time Elgar is happy to not even think of playing and shoulders his arms to a length ball wide outside off.
Length ball outside off, Elgar thinks to play but then hides his bat and lets it go through.
Around off, Elgar comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
And again, Elgar edges one down to third man for a couple. He is playing with soft hands really.
Wide outside off, left alone.

Almost a wicket! Good length outside off, Amla pushes at it. The ball moves away, Bairstow takes it tumbling to his right. The players appeal but are not too sure. Broad isn't confident either, for a change. Strange appeal. Replays confirm there was a spike on the Ultra Edge. That would have been out on review. What a miss this could be.
Shorter in length in line of the stumps, Amla ducks under it. He got out playing the pull shot in the first innings, he won't repeat his mistake this time.
Good length outside off, Amla comes forward and defends it.
Short and wide outside off, no shot offered by Amla.
Edged! Full and outside off, Elgar pushes at it and gets it wide of a diving Anderson at gully for a single to third man. Bowling to the field!
Broad wants a third man and he gets it.
Good length around off and middle, clipped down to fine leg for a single.

Edged! Good length outside off, Elgar looks to defend but gets an edge wide of the gully fielder. Two runs taken. Also brings up his fifty, 8th in Tests. He has played really well so far and will want to carry on.
Full outside off, Elgar presses forward and pushes it into the gap at covers for a couple of runs. He has been watchful today.
Wide outside off, Elgar is never going to play at that one.
A tad short outside off, Elgar raises his bat and lets it pass.
Slants it outside off on a length, Elgar lets it go through.
Good length around off, Elgar comes forward and closes the face of the bat to get it towards the leg side.
Length ball outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller outside off, Amla is not bothered.
Broad moves the two fielders in the deep a lot more finer.
Doles it outside off on a good length, Amla is happy to let it go through.
Amla comes forward and defends it nicely.
Good length outside off, Amla defends it towards covers.
Angles it outside off on a length, Amla defends it watchfully.
BEATEN! On a good length outside off, Elgar feels for it and hangs his bat out for it. The ball goes past the outside edge and England cannot believe their luck.
Slants it across Elgar who lets it go through easily.
Punches it into the off side for a single.
Angles it on a length, Amla gets across and turns it towards the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, solid back foot defence by Amla.
On a length around off, Amla gets in line and defends it.
England once again have a problem with the ball. The umpires are not changing it though. They changed it yesterday and the hosts ran through the visitors' lower order.

FOUR! Edged! Broad bowls it around off, Elgar shapes to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls past the second slip fielder for a boundary to third man. Root is applauding the ball but Broad is not happy.
FOUR! Nice shot! Full outside off, Elgar presses forward and creams it past mid off for a boundary. First one of the morning.
Hurls it around middle, Elgar comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Opened up! Broad angles it around off, Dean is opened up as he looks to defend. Manages to keep it out towards the off side.
Fuller outside off, Elgar pushes it back towards the bowler.
Around off on a length, Elgar gets across and turns it towards the leg side.
Stuart Broad to bowl from the other end. These two have done a lot of bowling for England.
Good length outside off, Amla dabs it towards gully from his crease.
Amla gets in line and defends this from his surface.
Edged! Full around off, Amla looks to push but gets it off the outer half towards covers. There was a hint of away swing for him.
Full around off, Amla gets across and defends it back to the bowler.
First runs of the day! Drifts it on the pads, Elgar tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Perfect! Hurls it outside off on a length, Elgar comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up. Just the start he would have hope for, with the edge though.
The players are in the middle. Dean Elgar and Hashim Amla are out to bat. England once again begin with James Anderson. Two slips in place for him. Here we go...

The deck has enough assistance for the pacers but the England bowlers have not been able to make inroads yet. They were gifted wickets in the first innings but they can't expect the visitors to repeat their mistakes. Batting will only get difficult on a deteriorating pitch and Joe Root will want his bowlers to trigger a collapse to keep the target in check. It is a massive test of his captaincy and caliber. Let's see how they fare today.

Hello folks! Welcome to the coverage of the Day 3 of the second Test between England and South Africa at Trent Bridge. The visitors are right on top after a brilliant second day. They gained a lead of 130 runs and the pair of Dean Elgar and Hashim Amla has been solid to stretch it past the 200-run mark. The Proteas will aim to extend it beyond the reach of England if possible. Will they be able to do it though?
... Day 3, Session 1.....

England's only way to restore parity was to nip out a cluster of wickets before close but it wasn't to be. Kuhn departed cheaply to Anderson but Elgar and Amla have been resilient, mixing positive intent with solid strokeplay. The duo has eased the lead past the 200-run mark. With three full days left, the tourists can call the shots now. Perhaps a target in the 350-375 range would be in du Plessis' mind although they have all the time to make as many as they want. Tough work ahead for England. Should be another action-packed day tomorrow. Join us at 1100 local, 1000 GMT for the third day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us!

There could have been an argument about who owned day one but not about today, certainly South Africa's day. The morning wasn't memorable as Anderson ripped through the remaining wickets to restrict the visitors. However, the Proteas mounted a sensational comeback in the last two sessions of the day to take a firm grip over this Test match. Root was the only England batsman who looked good while the others didn't apply themselves well. After Philander and Morkel started well, Maharaj and Morris finished things nicely to give the hosts a massive lead.
The slider on a shortish length outside off, Amla hangs back and punches it towards cover. That's the end of the day, STUMPS ON DAY 2.
Darted in around middle, firmly blocked off the middle of the bat by Hashim.
Flighted on off stump, Amla pushes at it with a slightly open bat face, got his bat down just in time as he could have been lbw if he hadn't done so.
Flighted around middle, Amla presses forward to defend off the inner half towards short leg.
Drifting in from around leg stump, Amla thought about the clip stroke but then lets it pass down the leg side to the keeper.
Floated on leg stump, Amla gets across to that one and bunts it to the ground near short leg.
Liam Dawson to bowl the final over of the day.
Fullish and on fourth stump line, easily left alone to the keeper.
Back of a length angled in from outside off, Elgar drags his bat inside the line as it whizzes through to Bairstow.
Another length ball this time wider outside off, easy leave for Elgar.
Angled in on a length on the fourth stump line, Elgar defends gingerly with an angled bat towards the off side. He is still feeling the pain it seems.
On a length outside off, Elgar lets it pass through to the keeper.

The physio is out there to attend to Elgar. The magic spray is out, should sooth some of the sting. The southpaw will happy that there are just few more minutes left to stumps. He can go off and then rest well. After a few minutes of hold up, Elgar is ready to resume. This could now probably be the last over of the day.

OUCH! That's hurt and Elgar is wincing in pain. On a length around off stump, extra bounce off the surface to rap him on the left forearm as he tries to defend. Instantly he is down on his knees, understandably so. That has surely stung.
Looped up well outside off, another leave from Amla.
Flatter outside off, Amla stays back and leaves it alone.
Floats it up on a length outside off, Amla hangs back and gets well outside the line before padding it away.
Drifting in from outside off, defends solidly from the crease.

Flighted on a length wider outside off, extra bounce as Amla offers no stroke. Struck high on the pad and it bobbles towards the off side. Stifled appeal for lbw but that didn't come back in enough, was too high anyway as well.
Floated around off stump, defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly to the off side.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.

Good length angled in around middle, Amla shuffles a long way across but misses the flick as the ball goes off the pads to the leg side. Loud appeal especially from Stokes for lbw but turned down. Root has a long thought but decides against the review after a chat with Bairstow. Replays show that it was clipping leg stump, so the on-field call would have stayed. Marginal decision, that!
Shortish and angled in on off stump, gets back and clips it to the leg side. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, leans into it and taps it towards cover.
On a length wider outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Ben Stokes comes into the attack.
Joe Root is back on the field.
Fullish outside off, Amla gets well forward to that one and defends it on to the track.
Floated outside off, stays back and defends it to the off side.
Flatter and short outside off, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated aorund middle, Amla gets back and works it with the turn behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Ali gifts a full toss and Amla doesn't miss out. Slaps it through mid-wicket with disdain to pick up another boundary. The lead goes past 200 for South Africa.

FOUR! Intent from Amla! Flighted outside off, uses his feet and lifts it straight over the bowler's head. Clinical strike and it goes away to the long off fence on a few bounces. He will want to unsettle the off spinner.
Joe Root has rushed off the field. Ben Stokes is the man in charge now.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards the man at mid off.
Good length closer to off stump, blocked solidly from the crease.

FOUR! That's been struck as straight as an arrow. Pleasing shot from Elgar. Leans into this full ball and smears the drive straight back past the bowler. It races down the ground to the fence for a boundary. Nicely timed!
On a shortish length outside off, stays back and defends it to the off side.
Leg bye! On middle and leg, leans across to flick but it goes off the pads towards square leg.
Length ball around off stump, Amla's bat comes down with a sledgehammer to block it.

FOUR! Risky shot but it comes off! Tossed up outside off, induces the drive from Elgar and it's a bit uppish but well past the short extra cover fielder. Rockets away to the fence for a boundary. Ali won't mind this as it's not easy to drive the ball that's pitching in the rough.
Flighted on off stump, Elgar leans into it and defends with an angled bat to the off side.
Full toss outside off, Elgar reaches out and taps it towards mid off.
Drifting in from around off stump, a bit of extra bounce and Elgar adjusts to tap it to the leg side.
Hashim Amla has been doing some adjustment with his stance. He was batting on off stump at Lord's. In this Test, he has stood outside leg at times. To the spinner, he is back to the off stump guard.
Floated outside off, presses forward and blocks it to the off side.
Floated around middle, Amla stands tall and whips it through square leg for a single.

First signs of spin as Moeen Ali comes on to bowl. Quite earlier than he came on in the first innings. The pitch conditions have a lot to do with this move, considering how well Maharaj got bite off the surface.
Length ball closer to off stump, defended solidly from the crease to the off side.
On a good length just outside off, Dean lets it pass through to the keeper.
Fullish around middle, gets across and defends it solidly to the leg side.
Broad wants a third man, he gets a third man.

FOUR! More runs to third man! Lot of runs in that zone today. On a length outside off, Elgar plays it with late with an angled bat, it goes off the edge just past a diving gully fielder, all the way to the fence.
Fullish and around off stump, solidly blocked with a forward press by Elgar.
Switches to over the wicket. Much better, since it brings a lot more forms of dismissals in play.
FOUR! Nicely done! Broad has been dishing out too many on the pads and this time Elgar finds the fence. Clips it elegantly through mid-wicket and the timing is spot on from the opener.
Back of a length closer to off stump, Amla shoulders arms to let it be.
Another short ball to follow up, this time Hashim decides to evade it.

FOUR! Pulled away! Amla hasn't played this shot well in this game so far but this is well done. Shortish on off stump, he swivels and hammers the pull nicely in front of square on the leg side. Rolled his wrists well to keep the ball down and it speeds to the fence for a boundary.
Short of a good length outside off, Amla stands tall and defends it to the off side.

FOUR! Through the gap! Back of a length outside off, Amla plays late with an angled bat. Soft hands and it's an educated edge that goes between the slips and gully. Trickles away to the third man fence.
On a good length just outside off, Amla watchfully lets it pass to the keeper.

Edged but doesn't carry! Elgar plays with soft hands and an angled bat to this length delivery outside off. The ball goes off the outside edge but on the bounce to second slip where Root makes a good stop.
Just short of a good length outside off, Elgar rides the bounce well and dabs with an angled bat towards gully on the bounce.
Pitched up and angled into the pads, Elgar gets across and clips it nicely through mid-wicket. The man in the deep covers good ground to his right and tidies up as the batsmen take a couple.

Bowls it from wide of the crease and pushes it up to the batsman outside off, a bit of inward movement as Amla gets a faint inside edge on to the pads. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket as the batsmen cross for a run.
Fullish and on the pads, Elgar flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish ball on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket but straight to the fielder. Elgar has missed out on the freebie.
Stuart Broad is back on for another spell.
Drinks break taken.
Back of a length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot towards extra cover.
Fractionally short of a good length outside off, Amla lifts his bat to make a leave.
Sharp bumper on off stump, Amla ducks under the bouncer rather comfortably.
Shortish and on leg stump, Elgar jumps around to fend it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and in the zone outside off, Elgar is right behind the line and defends solidly.
Back of a length outside off, defended solidly off the back foot by Elgar.

Interesting point from Shaun Pollock that despite batting on middle stump, Elgar plays a lot of balls wide outside off. Since he covers his stumps, in his first movement yet pushes away from his body. Something for Elgar to work on.
Fullish outside off, gets on the front foot and defends nicely on the bounce towards slip.
Length ball outside off, Amla defends it solidly from the crease to the off side.
Just short of Anderson! On a length outside off, Amla stays back to drive but mistimes it towards the bowler. Doesn't carry to Jimmy who tries in vain to take the return catch.
Back of a length outside off, Amla hangs back and defends it to the off side.
Fullish outside off, Amla gets on the front foot and defends gently to the covers.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and dabs it towards point.
Length ball around off, tails in a bit as Elgar gets across to tap it to the leg side.
On a length around off, defended with an angled bat towards point.
Short ball around off, Elgar sways away from the line of the bumper.
Pitched up around off stump, pushed gently towards the bowler.
Fuller ball outside off, leans into it and taps it towards mid off.
Dug in short just outside off, Elgar sways away from the bumper.
Fuller ball outside off, presses forward to that one and defends solidly to cover.
On a length outside off, probing line but Amla does well to let it pass.
Back of a length outside off, defended solidly from the crease to the covers.
Length ball just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
On a length outside off, Amla gets back and defends it towards the covers.
Length ball around off, Amla defends it solidly from the crease.
Good length closer to off stump, defends it solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Fuller and wider outside off, Elgar leans into it nicely and drives sweetly through the covers. Timing was the highlight and the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks it to the off side.
Good length ball outside off, Elgar presses forward and defends it towards cover where the fielder dives to get a hand on it to parry it towards mid off. Brace taken.
Length ball outside off, leans into it and defends gently towards cover.

FOUR! Loosener to start and put away. Wide half volley and Elgar essays a drive through cover-point. One hand came off while executing the stroke but timed it really well as the ball raced to the fence.
Joe Root brings on Mark Wood for a bowl. He will be under pressure to perform at the moment. Hasn't been among the wickets.
Amla comes right forward and defends it.
Good length around off, Amla gets in line and defends it.

FOUR! Sloppy from Wood! Shorter but on middle and leg, Amla gets across and pulls it towards fine leg. Mark Wood runs to his right from deep square leg, dives but parries the ball to the ropes. Amla is away!
On a length around off stump, played with an angled bat towards gully on the bounce
Hashim Amla walks out to bat at number three. There is a deep square leg in place already trying to catch him on the pull.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Anderson draws first blood and Root is absolutely pumped up. The outswinger on a length outside off, Kuhn pushes tentatively at it and gets a thick edge that flies low to second slip where the England captain gobbles it up. Just the start the hosts would have been hoping for after conceding a big lead.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards the mid off fielder.
Full and around off stump, Elgar defends around his front pad as the ball goes down the track to the bowler.
Fullish ball on the pads, leans across and clips it sweetly through square leg for a brace.
Another length ball closer to off stump, played with an angled bat and the ball goes on the bounce towards third man.
On a length closer to off stump, angling in, Elgar hangs back and defends solidly towards point.
Play and a miss! Just short of a fuller length outside off, straightens after pitching as Elgar is beaten on the drive. Loose stuff from both the South African openers so far.
Fullish and angling into the stumps, Elgar gets across and jams it towards mid-wicket.
Clips this one through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Full and outside off, Kuhn shapes to drive it through but is beaten by the away swing.
Full and around off, turned towards the leg side.
Lands it outside off, Kuhn lets it go through.

NOT OUT! Another review wasted by Root! Anderson bowls it around off, nips in as Kuhn comes forward to defend it. The ball raps him on the pads and the players go up for an lbw. The umpire says no. The bowler convinces his captain to go for the review and Root obliges. Ball Tracker shows that the ball was bouncing over the stumps. A review wasted. Think Root needs to take his time and consider more things before opting for the review. Replays show that Kuhn is batting way out of his crease, the players should have spotted that. With everyone interested in the review, nobody stops the ball and it runs into the fence. Leg Byes signaled for them.
England have opted for a lbw review against Kuhn. Could be quite close here if the impact is in line.
Full and outside off, Kuhn comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Good length just around off, Elgar plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Fuller and on the stumps, turned through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered by Elgar.
Goes round the wicket, angles it down the leg side, Elgar fails to clip it through.
Drives it towards extra cover and takes a single.
Lands it outside off on a length, Kuhn comes forward and defends it.
Lands it outside off, Elgar looks to hang his bat out for it but is beaten again. Top over from Anderson comes to an end.
Plays this towards point from his crease.
Too full outside off, Elgar squeezes it through covers for a couple of runs.
And again! Anderson slants it outside off, Dean looks to drive it through but fails to connect.
BEATEN! Outside off on a good length, Elgar looks to play at it but is beaten.
Full and outside off, Elgar looks to push but gets it off the inner half back down the wicket.
Kuhn comes forward to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid on. Maiden to begin for Kuhn.
A tad short outside off, Kuhn is not bothered.
Full and wide outside off, Kuhn looks to go hard through the covers but is beaten all ends up. You didn't see such shots in the first innings. Maybe the message is to be positive.
Full and outside off, no shot offered.
Good length outside off, left alone by Kuhn.
Good length outside off, Kuhn gets forward and defends it.
Stuart Broad to bowl from the other end. Three slips in place for him, no gully.
Full and just around off, pushed into covers for a quick single.
Comes forward and pushes it towards mid on.
Straight and in line of the stumps, Kuhn gets forward and turns it towards the on side.
Heino comes forward and defends it towards the off side.
Shorter in length, bounces more, Kuhn is taken back by the bounce but does well to keep it out.
FOUR! Ideal start for SA! Full and on the pads, Kuhn clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary to get off the mark. The lead should give him the freedom to score here?
